left.raw_text: The presence of a solid, malignant tumour, excluding lymphoma, that is resistance to standard therapies or for which no standard therapies exist

The presence of at least one lesion that can be accurately assessed at baseline by Computerised Tomography (CT), Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) or plain X-ray and is suitable for repeated assessment

right.raw_text: Estimated life expectancy of more than 12 weeks
